$comment: GTM-75. Single list of the Observatory's fixed sources F1-F44, read daily by observatory/collect.py. Methods and URLs transcribed from rosmarops-vigil docs/research/2026-11-01-observatorio-ampliacion-fuentes.md (signed 01-11) and docs/observatorio/fuentes-F1-F28.md (annex to GTM-75). public_url: the url of each source in 'checked' of observatory/daily/2026-11-03.json (commit aa5f165); Hermes Agent's from the annex. scope: the agent file in observatory/data/agents/ the source watches, 'threats' for the threat registries, 'all-agents' for cross-cutting sources. Tag patterns: 'v*' means v followed by a version number (likewise 'rust-v*', 'python-*', 'python-v*'); 'N.N.N' means three numbers without a prefix ('n8n@N.N.N': the same after a fixed prefix); null means every tag. Tags with alpha, beta, rc, nightly, preview, canary or dev are discarded; the rest are ordered like sort -V. read.notes is the order in which notes are looked for: 'github-api' (body of the GitHub release with that tag, read with the workflow's token; GTM-76), 'raw' (official CHANGELOG on raw.githubusercontent.com), 'web' (official changelog page), 'tag' (annotated tag text); an empty list means the source needs no notes.
